questions.q: How far ahead should I order?
questions.a: One week for cookies and loaves. Two weeks for custom orders, cookie trays and special requests. Holiday weeks fill fast, so earlier is better. Last-minute? Send the form anyway and I'll do my best.
Pickup only for now, in Richmond Hill. You'll get the address once your order is confirmed.
Interac e-Transfer. Custom orders need a 50% non-refundable deposit to book, with the balance due at pickup. Everything else is paid in full when booked.

Tell me about any allergies in your order. Gluten-free and egg-free options may be possible, but everything is made in a home kitchen that handles nuts, dairy, eggs, wheat and soy, so I can't guarantee anything is allergen-free.

questions.q: Can you make something that isn't on the menu?
questions.a: Often, yes. Use the special request form to tell me what you're looking for, whether it's a family favourite or a regional Italian treat, and I'll get back to you with a quote.

questions.q: How long do the cookies stay fresh?
questions.a: Most cookies stay fresh for 5 to 7 days in an airtight container at room temperature. Biscotti and pizzelle keep even longer. Filled cookies like bocconotti are best within 3 days.

questions.q: Do you make cookie trays for events?
questions.a: Yes. Mixed Italian cookie trays are perfect for showers, weddings, holidays and office gatherings. Send a special request with your date and number of guests.
